description: Feature BLoCs: GridBloc (feed listing with geo-filter), ProductBloc (single post schema, variant/package selection, cart/wishlist integration), CartBloc (order state), LocationBloc (GPS + manual location). All follow CubitSignal<S> pattern from bloc_signals. Each has a typed state record. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema/geo types) and FEAT-002 (repositories/services).
steps: Create lib/features/grid/grid_bloc.dart. State: GridState record with List<Map<String,dynamic>> entries, bool isLoading, bool hasMore, List<String> labels, String searchKeywords, LocationData? location. Extend CubitSignal<GridState> — constructor calls super(initialState: GridState(entries:[], isLoading:false, hasMore:true, labels:[], searchKeywords:'', location:null)). Methods: Future<void> loadFeed() — emit(state.value.copyWith(isLoading:true)). Call BloggerDataService().fetchFeed(labels: state.value.labels, query: state.value.searchKeywords, maxResults:20, startIndex:1). Filter results with GeoFilter.isServiceable(schema['areaServed'], state.value.location ?? LocationData.empty()). emit(state.value.copyWith(entries: filtered, isLoading:false, hasMore: raw.length==20)). Future<void> loadMore() — if already loading or !hasMore return. emit loading. fetch with startIndex based on current entries count. append and emit. void setLabels(List<String> labels) — emit new labels, call loadFeed(). void setSearch(String keywords) — emit new keywords, call loadFeed(). void setLocation(LocationData? loc) — emit new location, call loadFeed(). Define LocationData.empty() factory or handle null gracefully in GeoFilter. Add a static const _pageSize = 20.

Create lib/features/product/product_bloc.dart. State: ProductState record with Map<String,dynamic>? schema, bool isLoading, Map<String,dynamic>? selectedVariant, Map<String,dynamic>? selectedPackage, int qty. Extend CubitSignal<ProductState> — initial: ProductState(schema:null, isLoading:false, selectedVariant:null, selectedPackage:null, qty:1). Methods: Future<void> loadPost(String postId) — emit loading. Fetch via BloggerDataService().fetchPost(postId:postId). emit(state.value.copyWith(schema: fetched, isLoading:false)). void selectVariant(Map<String,dynamic>? variant) — emit copyWith(selectedVariant: variant). void selectPackage(Map<String,dynamic>? package) — emit copyWith(selectedPackage: package). void setQty(int qty) — emit copyWith(qty: qty.clamp(1, 99)). Future<void> addToCart(CartRepository repo) — build OrderItem from current schema/selectedVariant/selectedPackage/qty using SchemaExtractor; call repo.addItem(item). Future<void> addToWishlist(WishlistRepository repo) — call repo.add(postId from schema '@id' or passed-in id).

Create lib/features/cart/cart_bloc.dart. State is CartOrder (re-use model directly). Extend CubitSignal<CartOrder> — initial: CartOrder.empty(). Constructor takes CartRepository repo. Methods: Future<void> loadCart() — emit(await repo.load()). Future<void> addItem(OrderItem item) — emit(await repo.addItem(item)). Future<void> removeItem(String postId, {String? variantId}) — emit(await repo.removeItem(postId, variantId: variantId)). Future<void> updateQty(String postId, int qty, {String? variantId}) — emit(await repo.updateQty(postId, qty, variantId: variantId)). Future<void> clearCart() — emit(await repo.clear()).

Create lib/features/location/location_bloc.dart. State: LocationState record with LocationData? location, bool isLoading. Extend CubitSignal<LocationState> — initial: LocationState(location:null, isLoading:false). Constructor takes LocationService service. Methods: Future<void> loadSaved() — emit loading. loc = await service.loadLocation(). emit LocationState(location:loc, isLoading:false). Future<void> requestGps() — emit loading. loc = await service.getCurrentLocation(). if loc != null save and emit. else emit not-loading. Future<void> setManual(LocationData loc) — await service.saveLocation(loc). emit LocationState(location:loc, isLoading:false). void clear() — emit LocationState(location:null, isLoading:false).
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze exits 0 after these files are added
GridBloc, ProductBloc, CartBloc, LocationBloc all extend CubitSignal and have correct CubitSignal<State> type parameter

All state records have copyWith methods (Dart 3 records do not have copyWith — use classes or manually define; use plain classes with copyWith, not Dart records, since copyWith on a record is not built-in)
findings: NOTE: Dart 3 records do not auto-generate copyWith. Use plain immutable classes (final fields, const constructor, copyWith method) for all state objects in this project, NOT record syntax. This matches the CubitSignal pattern where state.value returns the state class instance.
